BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: Universe V3 says JSON candidates parse as strict JSON but defines no duplicate-object-member rule. Markdown duplicate metadata keys are explicitly rejected, while JSON duplicates are not. Duplicate top-level FINDING_ID/TYPE/SEVERITY/STATUS can therefore be accepted/rejected or resolved differently by different parsers.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: A JSON object containing two FINDING_ID members, or two SEVERITY members with different values, has no V3-mandated disposition or authoritative selected value.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define duplicate JSON object member handling explicitly and parser-independently.
Recommended fail-closed rule: any duplicate member name in a candidate JSON object => PARSE_ERROR with one exact conflict code; no normalized finding row is emitted.

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: RAW_EXTRACTION.JSON preserves exact top-level TYPE/SEVERITY/STATUS when present, but normalized_finding_row permits only JSON string or null. V3 does not define the exact disposition when one of those present fields is number/boolean/array/object.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: A valid JSON finding with SEVERITY=0 cannot satisfy normalized_finding_row.SEVERITY_RAW type, yet V3 does not say whether to emit PARSE_ERROR, UNSUPPORTED_CANDIDATE, RAW_FIELD_CONFLICT, or omit the row.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define exact invalid-authority-field-type codes and disposition.
Fail closed before normalized_finding_row creation when FINDING_ID/TYPE/SEVERITY/STATUS present with disallowed type.

BLOCKING_FINDINGS.ISSUE: validation_summary.errors is root-hashed, but there is no canonical error-code universe, no exact rule mapping each detected condition to one error row, and detail_hash hashes an undefined 'canonical diagnostic statement'. complete=true also does not explicitly require errors=[]; blocking_error_count is not normatively derived from the error rows.
BLOCKING_FINDINGS.COUNTEREXAMPLE: Two implementations can detect the same non-blocking/accounting condition, emit different diagnostic statements or error-row multiplicity, keep the same blocking_error_count, and produce different COMPLETE_FINDING_MANIFEST_ROOT_HASH values.
REQUIRED_REPAIR: Define a closed versioned validation error-code registry and exact one-condition-to-row derivation.
Replace free-form diagnostic statement hashing with a typed diagnostic-detail object and JCS hash, or exclude diagnostics from the authoritative root.
Define blocking_error_count exactly from error rows and require errors=[] when complete=true unless explicitly versioned non-blocking warning rows are part of the root model.

Define source_row_count == rows.length == input normalized_finding_rows.length after successful lossless adaptation.
Define adapter_status=VALID iff every precondition and every row mapping succeeds and all identity bindings validate; otherwise UNKNOWN_BLOCKING.
